What is Rhinoplasty?

Rhinoplasty, also known as a nose reshaping surgery, is a cosmetic and functional procedure that changes the shape, size and proportion of the nose. It can improve facial harmony, correct structural issues and help with breathing difficulties.

Key Benefits

  • Enhances facial balance and proportions
  • Improves nose shape and profile
  • Can improve breathing and nasal function
  • Boosts self-confidence
  • Long-lasting, natural-looking results

Are You a Suitable Candidate?

Rhinoplasty may be right for you if:

  • ✓ You are unhappy with the shape, size or proportion of your nose
  • ✓ You have a dorsal hump, bulbous tip, asymmetry or other structural concerns
  • ✓ You have breathing difficulties or nasal obstruction
  • ✓ You are in good general health
  • ✓ You have realistic expectations about the results

All procedure details, candidacy guidelines and recovery protocols are clinically verified by Dr. Girish A C, Lead Cosmetic Surgeon.

Our Rhinoplasty Process

1

Consultation

Discuss your goals, concerns, medical history and nasal anatomy.

2

Personalised Plan

A customised treatment plan tailored to your facial structure, aesthetic and/or functional needs.

3

Procedure

Performed using open or closed rhinoplasty techniques with precision and care.

4

Recovery & Support

Detailed post-operative care guidance on medication, activity, nasal care and follow-ups.

5

Follow-up & Review

Regular reviews to monitor healing and ensure optimal results.

Rhinoplasty Recovery & Results Timeline

First 48 Hours

Some swelling, mild discomfort and nasal splint.

Around Day 7

Splint removal and initial visible improvement.

Weeks 2-6

Swelling gradually reduces, you can resume most normal activities.

✨

Final Refinement

Final results can take up to 12 months as swelling fully settles.

Recovery time varies for each individual. Follow your surgeon's post-operative care instructions for the best results.

Types of Rhinoplasty

Aesthetic Rhinoplasty

Improves the shape, size and overall appearance of the nose. Ideal for cosmetic enhancement.

Functional Rhinoplasty

Addresses breathing problems and structural issues such as a deviated septum.

Revision Rhinoplasty

Corrects or improves results from a previous nose surgery.
